documents.title: Intimation Under Regulation 30 For Updated List Of Key Managerial Personnel Authorised To Determine Materiality Of An Event Or Information
Intimation For Appointment Of Cost Auditor Of The Company As Per Regulation 30 Of The SEBI (Listing Obligations And Disclosures Requirements) Regulations, 2015.
Intimation Under Regulation 30 Of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015 - Appointment Of Secretarial Auditor

analysis.summary: Vidya Wires Limited is a manufacturer of winding and conductivity products, currently holding the 4th largest market position in India. The company is undertaking a capacity expansion project to increase production from 19,680 MT to 37,680 MT, aiming to become the 3rd largest manufacturer in the sector. Management is focusing on diversifying its product portfolio into 20 categories and expanding its geographical footprint to drive export growth. The company maintains a de-risked business model with a wide customer base and is actively pursuing deleveraging strategies to reduce interest burdens. Vidya Wires reported a 5.1% year-on-year revenue increase for the first half of FY2026, with EBITDA margins improving by 50 basis points.

guidance.claim: The company expects to utilize 55% to 60% of its new capacity in the next fiscal year.
guidance.quote: the next year we see that new capacity will come up and we are looking around 55% to 60% of that capacity should be able to utilize.

demand_outlook.claim: Management sees a durable demand funnel across transmission, industrial, and renewable segments.
demand_outlook.quote: This creates a durable demand funnel across transmission, industrial, and renewable segments.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is nearly doubling its manufacturing capacity from 19,680 to 37,680 metric tons per annum.
capex_expansion.quote: We are nearly doubling our manufacturing capacity from 19680 metric tons per annum to 37680 metric tons per annum through our new facility Narsanda via our subsidiary called as ALCU Industries.

capex_expansion.claim: Construction of the new facility is over 75% complete, with operations expected to start in the final quarter.
capex_expansion.quote: we have probably completed more than 75% to 80 % of our construction and we believe in the last quarter, we will start our operations very soon.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margins improved by 50 basis points to 4.3% in H1 FY2026.
margins_costs.quote: The EBITDA margin increased to 4.3% an improvement of 50 basis points.

margins_costs.claim: The company utilizes a back-to-back pricing model to pass on LME price fluctuations to customers.
margins_costs.quote: Basically, we have a completely back to back pricing model. So about the pricing pass on, it would be 100% whatever price increase in the LME is there will be passed on to the customer.

orders_capacity.quote: currently our capacity is in like on an average 90% or so we are already utilizing it

capital_allocation.claim: The company has allocated ₹1,000 million for loan repayment or prepayment to reduce its interest burden.
capital_allocation.quote: ₹1,000 million allocated for loan repayment/prepayment to reduce interest burden.

capital_allocation.claim: Rs. 140 Crores of IPO proceeds are allocated for capital expenditure at ALCU Industries.
capital_allocation.quote: Rs. 140 Crores is allocated for capital expenditure at ALCU Industries; this will nearly double our capacity to 37,680 metric tons and enable new product lines.

capital_allocation.claim: Rs. 100 Crores of IPO proceeds are designated for debt repayment.
capital_allocation.quote: Rs.100 Crores is for repayment of borrowings.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company manages currency and LME price risks through hedging.
risks_headwinds.quote: it is entirely hedged, even the exchange rate is hedged on the RBI with the customer and with the supplier. So, not on LME as well as the exchange is any hit to our books of account.

management_commitments.claim: The company intends to use ₹1,000 million for debt reduction.
management_commitments.quote: ₹1,000 million allocated for loan repayment/prepayment to reduce interest burden.

management_commitments.claim: The company plans to start operations at the new facility in the final quarter of the current fiscal year.
management_commitments.quote: we believe in the last quarter, we will start our operations very soon.

management_commitments.claim: The company aims to reduce receivable days to 30 and inventory days to 20.
management_commitments.quote: Going forward, we will be trying to keep receivable days up to 30 days and basically inventory days up to 20 days.
